name: Selah Strong
bioAdditions: Path verified (Thompson S1): John Thompson -> Samuel (1668-1749) -> Susannah (1712-88, m. 1734 Thomas Strong) -> Selah: 2nd cousin 9 times removed. A 1792 engraving by Cornelius Tiebout shows 'the seat of the Hon. Selah Strong, Esqr., St. George's Manor' (S2).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Thompson route sourced; Bull Smith/Topping/Brewster routes from earlier rounds are not supported by anything found (his wife Anna was of the Tangier Smiths).

sources.citation: B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), p. 296
sources.supports: Samuel Thompson's daughter Susannah m. Thomas Strong; son Selah
